messages:
sara: ok team — putting the quickstart banner prototypes up for a final pass before we push to staging. link: https://figma.com/file/rdw-onboard/banners (check top-left variants)
mike: saw them. quick notes: keep it subtle, don’t steal top nav real estate. also need a clear skip for power users :)
alex: +1 on skip. from an implementation POV we should avoid mounting a huge overlay on app boot — prefer a thin banner with expand-to-modal behavior.
aria: research: 42% of new signups ignored first-run modals in our last test. We should surface 1) quick checklist, 2) sample projects, 3) try-with-your-data CTA. Keep copy scannable.
tom: accessibility nits: contrast ratio on the gray CTA (Try demo) is 3.8:1 in the Figma file — below 4.5. Also keyboard focus outline is hidden in the prototype. Need visible focus and aria-live for success/error toasts.
sara: good catches. Proposed updates: a) banner w/ 2 CTAs (Try demo / Skip tour), b) expand to a lightweight checklist modal only if user clicks Try demo, c) persistent pill in the header after dismissal so users can re-open onboarding.
alex: for persistence we can add a localStorage flag + server flag (for new users keep server flag until they complete onboarding). Implementation ETA ~3 days if we punt full telemetry until after launch.
mike: about sample projects — aria, can you confirm 3 starter projects we should show? We need names and one-line intros for each for the banner.
aria: suggested set: 1) "Chat Assist" — quick chat UI wired to any hosted model, 2) "FAQ Bot" — indexing site docs into embeddings, 3) "Summarize Pipeline" — ingest long docs and return summaries. Short descriptions will be used in the modal cards.
sara: copy tweak: change "Try demo" -> "Open demo" and microcopy under cards: "Clone & run in 1 minute". Also replace "Skip" with "Show me the console" to avoid negative phrasing.
tom: small A11y: ensure each card has role=button + aria-describedby referencing the short description. Cards should be navigable with arrow keys.
alex: dev note — we should include a URL param to bypass onboarding for power users: ?onboard=0. I'll add it to the docs and e2e tests.
sara: can someone draft the checklist items? I'm thinking: 1) Create API key, 2) Run sample project, 3) Check usage dashboard, 4) Set up team members.
mike: reorder: first API key, then sample project (so they can run it), then dashboard, then invite team. Also add an optional step for "configure private deployment" for enterprise users.
aria: experiment idea: show compact vs expanded banners to 50/50 split to measure clickthrough and completion rate.
alex: agree. telemetry: we'll emit events for banner_shown, banner_cta_click, onboarding_modal_open, onboarding_completed. I'll stub them for now.
sara: design-bot: can you run contrast check on the updated palette and export assets?
design-bot: run:contrast-check --file figma://rdw-onboard/banners --report new-contrast-1749005678
mike: last thing — copy for the header pill after dismissal: "Onboarding — Resume" (aria-hidden=false). Keep it collapsible.
sara: ok I'll update Figma with these changes, create a final PR for the frontend with the param and telemetry stubs. Meeting to review tomorrow 10:30am PT if anyone wants to walk through interactions.	om: I'll re-check the focus styles before the review. Thanks!
